keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (ADO Den Haag).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! PEC Zwolle 1, ADO Den Haag 0. Dylan Mbayo (PEC Zwolle) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Younes Namli.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Othniël Raterink replaces Jonas Jensen-Abbew.

Yannick Eduardo (ADO Den Haag) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Pascal Mulder (ADO Den Haag) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Thijs Oosting replaces Younes Namli.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Jesse Bal replaces Matej Sín.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Daryl van Mieghem replaces Nigel Thomas.
Olivier Aertssen (PEC Zwolle) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Matteo Waem (ADO Den Haag) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Ibrahim Cissoko replaces Dylan Mbayo.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Jan Bürger replaces Olivier Aertssen.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Donát Bárány replaces Yannick Eduardo.
Gilles van der Wal (PEC Zwolle) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Gilles Van Der Wal Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Ibrahim Cissoko (PEC Zwolle) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Tijs Velthuis replaces Tobias Sommer.
Delay in match because of an injury Milan Hokke (ADO Den Haag).
Delay in match because of an injury Gilles van der Wal (PEC Zwolle).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, PEC Zwolle 1, ADO Den Haag 0.
